王爱梅早就知道刘济民要去北影厂改稿子，甚至连大杂院和胡同里的人都知道了。
今天回到家，王爱梅更是兴奋。那可是改电影剧本啊，这是以前只能在报纸上看到的事儿。
晚上，王爱梅炒了一桌子菜，鼓励刘济民到燕影厂好好改剧本，尽早完成电影厂的任务。
王爱梅同志，还是太单纯了！
刘振国喝了一杯酒，笑问道：“老二，去燕影厂改剧本，一天补贴多少钱？”
“还有补贴？”王爱梅顿时来了精神。
“不多，也就一天两块钱。”
“两块钱？一天两块，一个月六十，比你爸还多挣四块钱。你要是...”王爱梅像是终于意识到了什么，低声问道：“你要是呆一年，能补贴一年不？”
“按道理是可以。”
“嘶！”
王爱梅眼中闪过一丝狡黠，随后又摇了摇头：“不行不行，公家的便宜不能占。”
“哈哈哈，看来你妈还是抵挡住了诱惑。”刘振国调侃道。
王爱梅羡慕地说道：“电影厂可真是好单位，真舍得给钱，他们也不怕有人占便宜。”
“你以为他们不知道啊？他们当然知道。占便宜他们也乐意，好人他们当了，钱是国家出。再说了，他们心底里觉得，应该给编剧点好待遇。”
一家人聊到十点，才刷碗睡觉。王爱梅将电风扇放到了刘济民旁边，说年轻人火力大，他们不热。
“妈，等剧本费发下来了，再买个电风扇。”
王爱梅笑着走进了内屋，开心地说道：“你先给自己买块表带着，你在家又待不了几天，要那么多电风扇做什么。”
翌日早上，刘济民起床后就直接回了学校，下午最后一节课后正式放假。
下了课，宿舍几人在食堂吃完饭就各自告别。外地的晚上赶火车，本地的直接就回家了。
“济民，你去燕影厂改剧本，我那角色的事儿？”杨波搂着刘济民的肩膀，乐呵呵地问道。
刘济民看了一眼杨波：“你真要？”
“哥们儿说是真的，哪怕是个小角色，我以后也有的吹啊！”
“那这样，你家电话多少，我到时候给你打电话。”刘济民问道。

Wang Aimei had known for a long time that Liu Jimin was going to Beijing Film Studio to revise the script, and even people in the courtyard and alley knew about it.
When I got home today, Wang Aimei was even more excited. That was changing a movie script. This was something that could only be seen in newspapers before.
In the evening, Wang Aimei cooked a table of dishes and encouraged Liu Jimin to go to Yan Film Studio to revise the script and complete the film studio's tasks as soon as possible.
Comrade Wang Aimei is still too naive!
Liu Zhenguo drank a glass of wine and asked with a smile: "Second brother, how much is the daily subsidy for going to Yan Film Studio to revise the script?"
"Is there any subsidy?" Wang Aimei suddenly became energetic.
"Not much, just two yuan a day."
"Two yuan? Two yuan a day, sixty a month, four yuan more than your dad. What if you..." Wang Aimei seemed to finally realize something, and asked in a low voice: "If you stay for a year, can you subsidize it for a year?"
"It stands to reason."
"Hiss!"
A hint of cunning flashed in Wang Aimei's eyes, and then she shook her head: "No, no, you can't take advantage of the public."
"Hahaha, it seems your mother has resisted the temptation." Liu Zhenguo teased.
Wang Aimei said with envy: "The film studio is such a good company, they are really willing to give money, and they are not afraid of anyone taking advantage."
"You think they don't know? Of course they know. They are happy to take advantage. They take advantage of good people, and the money comes from the state. Besides, deep down, they feel that the screenwriter should be given good treatment."
The family chatted until ten o'clock, then washed the dishes and went to bed. Wang Aimei put the electric fan next to Liu Jimin and said that young people have great firepower, but they are not hot.
"Mom, when the script fee comes down, I'll buy an electric fan."
Wang Aimei walked into the inner room with a smile and said happily: "Buy yourself a watch first. You can't stay at home for a few days, so why do you need so many electric fans?"
The next morning, Liu Jimin got up and went directly back to school. It was officially a holiday after the last class in the afternoon.
After class, everyone in the dormitory said goodbye after eating in the cafeteria. If you catch a train in the evening when you are out of town, you will go home directly if you are a local.
"Jimin, you went to Yan Film Studio to revise the script. What about my character?" Yang Bo put his arm around Liu Jimin's shoulders and asked cheerfully.
Liu Jimin glanced at Yang Bo: "Do you really want it?"
"Brother, it's true. Even if it's a small role, I'll be able to brag about it in the future!"
"Well, what's your home phone number? I'll call you then." Liu Jimin asked.
